论文摘要（原始）
We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution evidence into tasks and evaluation rubrics for continual learning. At its core is recursive-in-recursive self-improvement, a paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning: the inner recursion improves the harness with the model fixed, while the outer recursion trains the model under the improved harness. Harness evolution shapes training experience, and model learning creates new opportunities for harness adaptation. We present case studies of researcher interaction, harness refinement, and model learning, with the benchmark cases spanning four scientific task families. By releasing ScienceBuddy as a research product, we make this paradigm available to the scientific community and take a step toward discovery intelligence: scientific AI that advances through sustained collaboration with researchers and evolves alongside the research it supports. Website: http://science-buddy.io
AI 概括
Lyco 推眼镜，把论文拍在桌上：「来，咱们像讲八卦一样把这篇『ScienceBuddy』扒一遍。」
---
1️⃣ 背景：科学家太忙，AI 太笨，中间缺个「能一起长大」的搭档
现在的科研流程是这样的：博士生半夜跑实验、写代码、改图，累成狗；大模型虽然会写 Python、查文献，但一放到真实项目里就「幻觉满天飞、工具不会调、格式全靠猜」。现有的「智能体」要么是一次性提示词包，要么是死板的微调模型，既不会随着科学家的习惯进化，也不会把科学家的吐槽变成训练数据。论文一上来就扔出一个痛点：「我们要的是个能和人类『共同进化』的科研搭子，而不是个死板的外包工。」
---
2️⃣ 方法：套娃式「双重递归自进化」——把「工具链」和「大脑」轮流练级
核心招式叫 Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement（递归套递归自进化），听起来绕，拆开就两层套娃：
| 递归层 | 谁在动 | 干嘛 | 关键词 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内层 | Harness（工具链/工作流） | 模型参数冻结，让 Harness 自己进化：把科学家的自然语言反馈、报错堆栈、成功案例自动转成 任务卡 + 评分规则，再用进化算法/提示词优化把 Harness 磨得更顺手。 | Harness Evolution |
| 外层 | Model（大模型权重） | Harness 稳了，回头用新收集的「高质量轨迹 + 评分规则」做 RL / SFT，把模型练强。模型变强后又能解锁更高难度任务，给内层提供新素材。 | Model Reinforcement Learning |

哈喽！我是 Lyco。这篇论文 ScienceBuddy 乍一看标题绕口令——「Recursive-in-Recursive」（递归套递归），吓得我赶紧喝口水压压惊。读完发现，它其实是在造一个「会越用越懂你、越用越强」的科研 AI 伴侣，核心思想倒挺朴素：把「工具进化」和「模型进化」拧成麻花，让人类科学家在日常吐槽、改需求、看结果的过程中，顺手把 AI 养成了专属「得力助手」。
下面用 4 段大白话给你过一遍全貌，最后再吐个槽。
---
1. 背景：科学家不想当「提示词工程师」，想要「会长大」的搭档
现在的科研 Agent（智能体）要么是「一次性外卖」——跑完一单就扔，下次还得重新教；要么是「死板的流水线」——换个数据集、换个实验设计就得改代码、改 Prompt、改评测集，累得科学家不如自己写脚本。
作者痛定思痛：真正的「发现智能」得像真人助手一样，跟着 PI（课题组长）混日子，天天看实验记录、听吐槽、改方案，自己在后台偷偷进化。所以他们不搭 Benchmark、不跑榜单，直接把 ScienceBuddy 做成一个 「可交互的科研工作台」 扔给真人用，边用边练。
---
2. 核心方法：双层递归——「鞭子进化」套「马儿进化」
这是全文最硬核、也最像「套娃」的设计，分内外两层循环：
| 递归层 | 谁在动？ | 干嘛？ | 关键产物 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内层（Harness Evolution） | 系统/工程师（或自动化脚本） | 模型参数冻结，只改「马具」：Prompt 模板、工具调用链、检索策略、评分 Rubric、少样本示

模式: 沉浸阅读高引用论文 (roll=34)

阅读记录：Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
来源: semanticscholar | 年份: 2023 | 引用: 8295 | 链接: https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/83b90f4a0ae4cc214eb3cc140ccfef9cd99fac05
论文摘要（原始）
High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2--4× with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.

However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. 论文摘要（原始）
High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2--4× with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.

哈喽，我是 Lyco。这篇论文是 vLLM 那篇奠基之作（OSDI '23），也是大模型推理系统里“分页注意力”概念的源头。咱们按惯例，三五段给你梳理清楚，最后再来点“毒舌/彩蛋”时间。
---
1. 背景与痛点：KV Cache 是个“内存杀手”
大模型推理时，为了不重复算已经生成过的 token，必须把每层的 Key/Value 存下来，这就是 KV Cache。问题在于：它巨大、动态、且长短不一。
* 巨大：几十亿参数模型跑几千 token，显存轻松几十 GB 起步。
* 动态：请求到来/结束、生成长度未知，显存像租房子一样频繁申请释放。
* 碎片化：传统系统（如 FasterTransformer、Orca）用连续内存块存 KV Cache，导致严重的内部碎片（预分配太多浪费）和外部碎片（零散小块拼不出大块）。结果就是：显存明明没满，却跑不了更大 batch，吞吐上不去。
---
2. 核心方法：PagedAttention —— 把 OS 的“虚拟内存/分页”搬进 Attention 里
作者灵光一现：为啥不把 KV Cache 当成“虚拟内存”管起来？
* 分页存储：把连续的 KV Cache 切成固定大小的 Block（页）（默认 16 或 32 个 token）。逻辑上连续，物理上不连续，散落在显存各处。
* 页表映射：每个请求维护一个逻辑 Block 到物理 Block 的映射表（Block Table），Attention 算子里通过查表、间接寻址把离散的 Block 串起来算。
* 写时复制：多请求共享同一段前缀（如 System Prompt、Few-shot 示例、Beam Search 的公共祖先）时，只引用同一组物理 Block，修改时才复制。这波操作直接把“共享前缀”从应用层优化下沉到了内存管理层。
